subject: Shadow pilot: provisioning additional teams/apps, phased keys & term sync
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stella Jacobs <stella.jacobs@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@novapulse.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Shadow pilot: provisioning additional teams/apps, phased keys & term sync

Hi Stella —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick follow up with a proposal we can move on this week: Novapulse wants to roll Redwood into two additional internal teams (Recommendations & Customer Insights) and spin up 12 new service/API keys (6 staging / 6 prod) tied to the existing account.

High level ask from your side: confirm whether you want keys issued all at once or phased by team, and whether procurement prefers a single addendum for the expansion or a separate PO for the pilot tranche.

Proposed next steps from us:
- Draft an addendum that covers +12 keys, 12-month term extension of the pilot SKU, and a 30% increase on the commitment baseline for predictable capacity.
- Offer phased key issuance (staging → prod) over a 3-week cadence, with a short validation window per team.
- Provide a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a DocuSign-ready addendum draft by EOD tomorrow.

Attaching a one-page pilot SOW and a rollout cadence for visibility. Looping Tom for SRE/traffic expectations.

What I need from you: preference on phased vs. all-at-once keys, and whether procurement should be on the same DocuSign envelope.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Stella Jacobs <stella.jacobs@novapulse.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novapulse.ai, Tom Harris <tom.harris@novapulse.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Shadow pilot: provisioning additional teams/apps, phased keys & term sync

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 09:14 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick follow up with a proposal we can move on this week...

Thanks Karthik — this looks promising. A few quick items from our side:
- We prefer a phased issuance: spin up Recommendations first (4 staging / 4 prod), then Customer Insights (2/4) — reduces blast radius.
- Procurement would like the addendum in a single envelope that covers both teams and the 12-month extension. They asked to review a draft before DocuSign.
- Traffic note for SRE: during our weekly batch window (Tues 02:00–05:00 UTC) we see large volume spikes; need to understand how the extra capacity would affect burst pricing / SLA.

Looping procurement and Tom to keep them in the thread. Please include a clear: (a) per-key cost, (b) committed capacity delta, (c) rollback policy if quality regressions occur after rollout.

—Stella
Stella Jacobs
Head of Platform Engineering, Novapulse
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stella Jacobs <stella.jacobs@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@novapulse.ai>, procurement@novapulse.ai
Date: 2026-11-12T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Shadow pilot: provisioning additional teams/apps, phased keys & term sync

Thanks — appreciate the specifics. Attached: draft addendum (covers +12 keys and 12-month extension) and a Pilot KPIs & Rollout Cadence workbook. Key points called out in the doc:
- Per-key pricing: preserved at your current per-key price for the first 90 days of the pilot, then standard metered rates unless we agree on a revised commitment.
- Committed capacity delta: proposal increases baseline by 30% (burstable up to 2x for scheduled batch windows).
- Rollback: automatic traffic diversion to the existing model variant if an eval/regression threshold is hit; we’ll include a 48-hour mitigation SLA in the addendum.

Naomi / Ben — can you review the capacity numbers in the workbook (tab: capacity-forecast) and confirm whether we can cover peak batch windows without a dedicated pool, or whether we should recommend reserved capacity for that first 6-week pilot window?

Stella — I’ll produce a MAP doc and a DocuSign link once we align on the capacity path.

—Karthik
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stella Jacobs <stella.jacobs@novapulse.ai>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@novapulse.ai>, procurement@novapulse.ai
Date: 2026-11-13T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Shadow pilot: provisioning additional teams/apps, phased keys & term sync

Quick capacity readout after reviewing the workbook:
- We can absorb the +30% baseline with existing hosted pools for the pilot if Novapulse accepts a soft-SLA for batch bursts (latency SLOs of 95th percentile 220ms rather than 150ms during batch windows).
- If Novapulse needs hard SLAs for the batch window, recommend a temporary Dedicated pool for the 6-week pilot (estimate: 1x A10/T4-equivalent, cost delta enclosed in attachment).
- We can issue the 12 API keys in phases as requested; suggest the following cadence: Week 0 (4 staging keys), Week 1 (4 prod keys — Recommendations), Week 3 (remaining 4 prod for Customer Insights).

Pricing tweak proposal for procurement: 10% credit applied to incremental usage for the first 3 months of the pilot if they sign the 12-month addendum now.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Stella Jacobs <stella.jacobs@novapulse.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novapulse.ai, Tom Harris <tom.harris@novapulse.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Shadow pilot: provisioning additional teams/apps, phased keys & term sync

Thanks Naomi — that readout is helpful. Procurement will take the 10% credit offer under review; they asked for the following in the MAP before they sign:
- Clear acceptance criteria per team (latency, error rate thresholds)
- A rollback playbook and who on both sides owns which step
- DocuSign-ready addendum and an exact invoice schedule (monthly vs. upfront)

One more ask: can Redwood also provide a short runbook for key rotation and a recommended safelist for the staging keys? Our security team will want that documented.

If you can get the MAP + DocuSign link over by EOD Monday, procurement will aim to review and return comments within 48 hours.

—Stella
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stella Jacobs <stella.jacobs@novapulse.ai>, procurement@novapulse.ai
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@novapulse.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T08:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Shadow pilot: provisioning additional teams/apps, phased keys & term sync

Stella — attaching the MAP and the DocuSign envelope link below. Items included in the MAP:
- Acceptance criteria per team (latency, error-rate thresholds)
- Rollout cadence and key issuance schedule (as Naomi suggested)
- Rollback steps and contact list (on-call SRE + Redwood support rotation)
- Key rotation runbook + safelist recommendations (security appendix)
- Invoice schedule: monthly in arrears for metered usage; addendum prepays the 30% baseline uplift for the first 30 days to guarantee capacity.

Links & assets:
- HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood/deals/DEAL-5493
- Drive (MAP & docs): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/novapulse-pilot
- DocuSign (addendum envelope): https://www.docusign.com/templates/novapulse-addendum

Next steps:
1) Stella/procurement: confirm they’re happy with the MAP language and payment cadence.
2) Once confirmed, we’ll send DocuSign and schedule the first key issuance (aiming for Week 0 on your calendar).
3) Ben / Naomi coordinate the capacity switch if we need a temporary Dedicated pool.

If procurement wants any line-item changes for the invoice schedule, ping me and I’ll loop finance. Thanks — looking forward to getting this going.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
